The longest‑lasting dynasty in Chinese history is the **Zhou dynasty** (c. 1046 – 256 BCE, about 790 years).  
Its founding monarch was **King Wu of Zhou** (Ji Fa), who overthrew the last Shang king at the Battle of Muye and began the Zhou reign.
